<thought>The spectrum shows a main peak at m/z 194.09 (intensity 100) and a second peak at +2 Da (m/z 196.08) with intensity ≈33 % of the base peak, which matches the characteristic 3:1 (≈75 % : 25 %) isotopic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl). No other element shows a distinctive isotopic pattern (e.g., bromine would give ~1:1, sulfur gives only a few % at +2). Therefore chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
